title: Tracecat 1.4.0-alpha.1
body_markdown:
## Security


- fix(agents): Require agent:update for the preset builder chat ([#4056](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4056) )


## Deprecations


- feat(integrations): Expand CrowdStrike templates and fix list actions ([#4049](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4049) )


## Case management


- perf(cases+engine): Index workflow and case task foreign keys ([#4016](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4016) )
- feat(cases+actions): Add delete case comment action ([#4031](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4031) )
- feat(cases+actions): Add core.cases.run_task to run a case task ([#4032](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4032) )


## Agents


- perf(agents): Read MCP integrations once, discover servers in parallel ([#4017](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4017) )
- feat(agents): Resolve secret expressions in remote MCP headers ([#3982](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3982) )
- feat(agents): Emit per-backend agent turn and TTFT metrics ([#4033](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4033) )
- fix(agents): Stop session row locks blocking runtime writes ([#4037](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4037) )
- fix(agents): Pass system prompt by file and cap case chat payload ([#4036](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4036) )
- fix(agents): Check the backend entitlement on every turn ([#4047](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4047) )
- feat(agents): Let agent backends prepare and clean up session deletes ([#4048](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4048) )
- fix(agents+api): Allow managed skill saves and keep AWS mappings ([#4055](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4055) )
- refactor(agents): Remove the retired internal agent routes ([#4053](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4053) )


## Tracecat MCP


- feat(mcp): Add create, update and delete workspace variable tools ([#3945](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3945) )


## Integrations


- perf(integrations): Build the JSONPath parser on first use ([#4039](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4039) )
- fix(integrations): Promote the registry version after a long build ([#4041](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4041) )
- feat(integrations): Add incident.io API actions ([#4007](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4007) )


## Engine


- perf(engine): Skip redundant reads on action, trigger and webhook paths ([#4018](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4018) )
- perf(engine): Resolve for_each credentials once per loop ([#4015](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4015) )
- fix(engine): Retry sandbox cgroup setup when a process races in ([#4028](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4028) )
- feat(engine): Trace phases inside action execution ([#4038](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4038) )
- perf(engine): Clone each sandbox jail into its memory cgroup ([#4040](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4040) )
- perf(engine): Return sandbox action results before the jail exits ([#4042](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4042) )
- fix(engine): Kill the whole jail and bound sandbox teardown ([#4045](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4045) )
- revert(engine): Back out the jail fast path and teardown changes ([#4046](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4046) )


## API


- fix(rbac): Enforce grant limits on SCIM mappings and token issuance ([#4020](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4020) )
- feat(api+ui): Deploy managed resource packages to customer workspaces ([#4025](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4025) )


## Infrastructure


- feat(infra): Run a lighter dev stack by default in just cluster ([#4021](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4021) )
- fix(infra+docs): Default Compose to latest image tag ([#4024](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4024) )
- fix(infra): Harden latest across image publishers ([#4030](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4030) )
- docs(infra): Verify all three images before a release ([#4034](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4034) )
- revert(infra): Restore the sandbox overlay's backend default ([#4035](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4035) )
- ci: Stamp a unique registry version on non-release images ([#4029](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4029) )


## Contributors


[@daryllimyt](https://github.com/daryllimyt) ,[@aaron-tracecat](https://github.com/aaron-tracecat) and[devin-ai-integration\[bot\]](https://github.com/apps/devin-ai-integration)


**Full changelog** :[1.3.1...1.4.0-alpha.1](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.3.1...1.4.0-alpha.1)
